data.title: Iran fills senior military posts left vacant after Israeli-US strikes | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: Ahmad Vahidi was formally named IRGC chief as Khamenei filled six senior military positions following the deaths of their predecessors in Israeli-US strikes.
